 Oskar Pietuszewski only for Champions League as Chris Smalling injury worries Porto 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article FC Porto will be without Oskar Pietuszewski against Estoril on Saturday at 20:30, the winger still treating a left thigh muscle issue. Farioli plans to hold the 18-year-old back for Wednesday’s Champions League tie with Napoli, with Porto pursuing a 10th successive league win, a mark unmatched this season after Barcelona slipped in La Liga’s 10th round.
 According to O Jogo, Borja Sainz and Pepê, rested in the League Cup, are in line to start, supporting Samu, who was not in the squad midweek.
 OneFootball Videos
 Chris Smalling , injured on his debut night, has been reassessed and scans revealed damage to the medial collateral ligament in his right knee. The update did not specify the severity or whether surgery might be needed, and for now he will follow conventional treatment to avoid an operation. The lay-off is, at best, several weeks and it is very unlikely the England international plays again in 2026.
 Vasco Sousa, William Gomes and the already mentioned Pietuszewski remain in recovery and will miss this match. William is only due back after the international break.
 With the Ac. Viseu regulars limited to recovery work, Farioli drafted 10 academy players into training. António Ribeiro, Hjalte Froholdt and Martim Cunha, Eirik Granaas, and forwards Domingos Muxito, Cardoso Varela and Mame Niang came from the B team, with Marco Silva, João Brito and António Neto stepping up from the under-19s. Another session is scheduled today at Olival, after which Farioli will hold his pre-match press conference.
 Source: O Jogo
